digest.component_or_area: enrichment queue and digest history storage
propositions: Physical deletion of committed enrichment events causes git rename-detection conflicts during cross-clone merges without reclaiming repository space
Current queue reduction in overlap/queue.py opens and parses every matching event file per ticket, making pending_enrichment scans O(history) and exceeding the 20ms drain-gate budget
A newest-first suffix-lazy reader bounded by filename timestamps can reduce file opens from 4977 to 1658 per full-store scan without violating merge-safety or invariant I1
Lexicographic filename order (timestamp-uuid-TYPE.json) matches monotonic timestamp order, enabling deterministic suffix reads without retention lifecycle or deletion
Any merge-safe removal scheme must produce deterministic identical-content renames to source-derived paths; physical prune with fresh UUIDs violates this rule and breaks reconvergence
